Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play · Travel & transport

truck noun

also toy truck, lorry, pickup truck, pickup

modern

M-O s.v. truck

vehiculum onerārium; vehiculī onerāriī n.

Recorded by Morgan–Owens. Add lūsōrium for our toy application.

Other words

  • plaustrum, plaustrī n. — pickup truck

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Andresian p. 40; Traupman 403: (for farm purposes) wagon

    Classically the heavy farm wagon or cart (Cato, Agr. 2.7; Cic. Div. 1.57, from Lewis & Short), and Traupman’s farm wagon. Andresian puts it under a picture of a pickup truck, the farmer’s vehicle of today.

  • autocīnētum onerārium — a truck, a lorry

    also used · modern · Traupman 219, 398

  • autocarrum, autocarrī n. — a truck

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 219

    Formed on carrus, a Gaulish wagon (Caes., Lewis & Short).

See also dump truck, trailer, tractor, car.
